text:
maria (PM): Heads-up — planning a staggered rollout for model-v2 that needs to cover hosted + dedicated + private. Goal: surface to 3% of live traffic in US first, expand to beta tenants, then full. Need clear launch criteria and per-tenant kill-switches.

sam (eng): sounds good. do we want a single feature flag or per-tenant flags? per-tenant gives control but adds complexity.

maria (PM): prefer per-tenant with a global master flag. customers on contracts >$X should be manually opt-in. also need automatic fallback to model-v1 on latency/quality regressions.

lee (sre): +1 per-tenant. we should attach circuit-breaker metrics: p95 latency, error-rate, token-queue-depth. If any metric crosses threshold for N minutes, trigger auto-fallback.

anjali (cs): We'll need a customer communications plan for beta tenants; also list of tenants that get early opt-in. can we expose a tenant-level dashboard for toggles?

maria (PM): yes — prod-ops will expose toggle + history. Olivia, can you scope the UI work?

olivia (prod-ops): can do. suggest simple schema for flags first, then UI. propose API + console. sample flag config:
```yaml
flags:
  - name: model_v2_enabled
    master: true
    per_tenant: true
    rollout_strategy:
      type: staged
      stages:
        - name: internal
          tenancy: org-internal
          pct: 100
        - name: us_canary
          region: us
          pct: 3
        - name: beta_tenants
          tenants: [tenant-123, tenant-456]
          pct: 100
```

sam (eng): love the schema. for canaries we should implement shadow traffic sampling for 48 hours before surfacing results. also we need an A/B test variant for quality evals (auto-roll metrics).

lee (sre): agree on shadowing. add: if KV-cache warm-up hits <X tokens/sec, delay ramp. we should also ensure cache invalidation plan when rolling model variants.

david (security): for private deployments, we must ensure flag toggles are audited and cannot be toggled remotely without a signed request. include KMS signing check. also confirm logging retention for toggles as it's part of SOC2.

anjali (cs): for customer gating: can we offer an SLA-backed opt-in for a small set of paying customers? they'd want rollback guarantees and a direct contact for incidents.

maria (PM): yes — propose a "beta SLA" doc: 4-hour incident contact + automatic rollback on defined thresholds. Olivia can draft.

olivia (prod-ops): will draft. question: what's our launch criteria checklist? my first pass:
- shadowing 48h with no perf regressions
- p95 latency delta < 15% vs model-v1
- error-rate < 0.5%
- no quality regressions on smoke prompts (automated eval)
- toggle + audit logs working for private deployments
- rollback automation tested in staging

sam (eng): add: end-to-end canary deploy tested across Dedicated and Private. validate kernel fallbacks for quantized variants.

lee (sre): add SLA enforcement test: simulate tenant traffic spike and ensure fallback triggers. also run the throttling policy test.

maria (PM): great. next steps: Olivia to draft UI + beta SLA, Sam to define infra toggles + shadowing plan, Lee to author SRE runbook with thresholds, Anjali to confirm customer invite list and comms. I'll sync with Sales on contract clauses.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary-config branch (sha: abc123) — running smoke tests.

sam (eng): noted. I’ll watch the smoke suite and post results here.

maria (PM): thanks everyone. follow-up sync Wed 10am to lock launch window. :thumbsup:
